scope: Mayfair 2010/2013 English 2–4-player base; original four-page baseline plus positively applicable base clarifications from publisher previous-Mayfair unified rulebook. No Up!, Underworld, Americana, Con Jobs, revised-2024/six-player or optional Gamble Variant rules imported.

checks.evidence_and_assessment: Original pp1–4 govern the 2–4-player base game. Unified p2 explicitly directs ignoring absent expansion elements. Summary uses the 9 usable tiles/color, 12 dice, 10 markers, four player colors and 49-card base deck; it excludes risers, Underworld effects, extra actions, six-player modifications and laying-off.

Original p2 and unified p5 support two initial properties, starting money from their printed card amounts only, corresponding visible discards, scoring chips at zero, banker, and End of Game atop the fourth quarter beneath the other three. Unified p16 expressly supplies the two-player F-card setup replacement.

Original pp2–3: acquire the drawn space, pay all marked lots, pay indicated casinos, record boss points and discard before Play. Unified pp7–9 clarifies own sprawled die remains unchanged and immediate boss settlement. Summary preserves the order and separates immediate End of Game handling.

Original p2: replace another player’s sprawled die retaining its current pip value; a tile without a die uses the printed board value. Summary keeps the tile, distinguishes these values and applies supply and boss rules.

Original p2 and unified pp7–8 support every marked lot paying its owner $1, regardless of turn/color, with built tiles no longer lots; paying casinos pay every investor per die pip. Summary distinguishes these payments.

Original p2 supports color payouts anywhere and Strip eligibility by an edge. Unified p8 expressly says a qualifying Strip casino pays for all its tiles. Summary accurately includes whole-casino payout and excludes diagonal-only connection.
Original p3: own lot, remove marker, choose tile, pay printed lot price, place own die at printed board value. Availability and immediate same-color merging are preserved.

Original p3: boss only, empty unowned edge-adjacent lot, twice printed price, available matching-color tile, own die at printed value; property-card risk remains. Summary includes each restriction and outcome.

Original p3 and unified p11: boss only, whole casino, sufficient new-color tiles, $5 per tile/space, replace and return old tiles; diagram preserves dice and illustrates a merger handing control to Yellow’s higher die. Summary faithfully includes these outcomes.

Original p3 and unified p11: at least one own die, boss status unnecessary, pay all casino pips, each player rerolls all their own dice and returns them among their own prior holdings. No casino containing an already reorganized die can be reorganized again that turn, including after a merger. Summary distinguishes paid reorganization from unrestricted free tie rerolls.

Original p4 and unified p13: once on acting player’s turn at another player’s casino; boss receives House card; wager capped by tile count and both players’ cash; gambler rolls two dice; listed win/double/loss sums and net transfers match. Doubled winnings stop at boss cash. Summary’s net-transfer presentation adequately captures retention/return of the stake; physical placement on House card is not a material omitted outcome.

Original p4 and unified p9: only cross-player highest ties trigger immediate free rerolls of every currently highest die; reassess all dice, no smaller-tie rerolls, and a sole player owning several highest dice needs no reroll. Unified forbids actions or initiated trades until resolution finishes. Summary preserves the example’s lower untouched die becoming boss.

Both books explicitly assign players their own rolls for paid reorganization. Their free boss-tie instructions specify which dice reroll without expressly assigning a physical thrower. Summary accurately reports that silence without inventing an official actor assignment.

Original pp2–3 and unified pp8–9: only boss gets tile-count points, each casino separately smallest first with choice among equal sizes; insufficient points stop before numeric gaps and excess is lost. Summary reproduces the 8-to-10/12 examples and prohibits combining separate casinos.

Original p3 and unified p6 support nine usable tiles/color, recycling an own die when all twelve are on board, a vacated tile retaining casino point value but having no owner, marker recycling with loss of vacated-lot ownership, unlimited bank and public money/piece counts/discards. Unified explicitly limits ownership-die exhaustion to placement and permits any dice for gambling. Summary includes these clarifications.

Original p4 and unified p15: any-time/off-turn trading, multiplayer trades, money/lots/casino dice/current-turn acting-player actions; replace marker or die with recipient’s, preserving pip value; no points/tiles/future-turn promises or another player’s actions. Summary correctly includes immediate tie settlement and unified rule stopping subsequent trade steps if a necessary element fails.

Original p4: immediate End of Game trigger, final all-owned-lot plus Strip payout, most points then most money, and immediate base victory at 90+. Unified p16 confirms no actions/initiated trades on End draw; summary excludes Underworld end scoring. Neither book supplies a further equal-money tiebreak, and summary says so.

Original p4 and unified p16: no building on F, no marker for F draws, normal lot/casino payments and scoring, discard then repeat property draw until A–E, with F setup cards replaced. Summary preserves repeated payouts without intervening Play and immediate End of Game precedence.

No material unsupported rule, misleading generalization, or omitted base procedure found. Setup highest-roll ties and a further equal-points/equal-money tiebreak are not resolved by these sources; no invented ruling is required. Routine action payment destination is not expanded into an official actor/destination ruling absent explicit source support.

delivery_validation.pdf_usage: PDF bytes hashed for input identity. Their extracted complete text and all seven supplied native page images were inspected; PDFs were not separately rendered and no excluded PDF rules were imported.

native_inspection_evidence.evidence: Original p1: visually inspected three-column components and board illustration; verified 2–4-player header, replacement-tile footnote, player colors/counts and distinct scoring/wager/discard areas.

Original p2: visually inspected setup left column and quarter-deck diagram, ownership/Draw center column, payout and score right column. Text extraction begins with right-column material; native page confirms correct procedural reading order. Example gold casinos distinguishes Strip edge eligibility from color payout.

Original p3: visually inspected continuation of scoring at upper left, Step 2 and supply restrictions below; build and sprawl center, remodel and reorganize right. Scoring-track inset verifies numeric gaps; action diagrams retain dice and distinguish build printed values from existing casino holdings.

Original p4: visually inspected reorganize continuation and gamble left column, boss ties center, trading/winning/two-player right. Boss diagram shows rerolled 5s dropping to 3 while unchanged Green 4 takes control. Optional Gamble Variant is a distinct labeled section and excluded.

Unified physical p2: visually inspected GAME SETS text directing players to ignore rules for absent Up!/Underworld elements. This is the basis for admitting positive base clarifications without importing expansion systems.

Unified physical p5: visually inspected two-column setup/initial properties and End of Game quarter-deck illustration. Underworld-deck setup is a separate expansion instruction and excluded; base deal, initial money and discard instructions match baseline.

Unified physical p16: visually inspected WINNING left column and 2-PLAYER RULES right. Setup F-card discard/replacement is explicit. Underworld card scoring/effects are visibly distinct expansion content and excluded; no-action/no-initiated-trade End restriction applies to base.

independence_statement: Independent pure source audit. Read only the three designated complete text inputs and seven designated native images; hashed only designated input files including the two PDFs. Did not read questions, keys, scope maps, answers, grades, other audits/reviews, QA reports, parent history, chats, runtime metadata, or web; did not consult readers or other agents and used no collaboration/list_agents tools. Did not modify candidate or sources. Only this source-audit.json was written. All requested full-text and native-image inspection was completed.
